title: ERIS vs Slack
content_html:
Slack is built for teams that need a central place to chat, share files, and integrate other tools into one conversation stream. It works well as a communication layer on top of your existing software.

ERIS is built for companies that want to replace multiple business tools (CRM, project management, document handling, finance, HR and more) with one system that runs on their own servers, with an AI assistant that answers questions across all of them using company data.

Choose Slack if your main need is team messaging and you want to keep your other business software separate. Choose ERIS if you want one system for the whole business, with a local AI model, so no outside AI provider receives company data.

What Slack is good at

Slack describes itself as an AI work platform for managing projects, automating workflows, and connecting teams securely. According to its website, Slack brings people and AI agents together to work.

Slack's channels work for teams from 10 to 10,000 people. Slack Connect channels let you work with customers, partners and agencies outside your company as closely and securely as you work with your own team.

Slack includes a conversational CRM called Slack CRM, powered by Slackbot, where you can capture contacts and move deals forward right from conversations.

Slack offers integrations with Salesforce agents through Agentforce, so Salesforce agents can take action within Slack. It also offers fast answers using Claude.

Slack's free plan keeps message history for 90 days and allows up to 10 apps. Slack offers paid plans and a free plan that can be upgraded at any time.

What ERIS does differently

ERIS is in development. The beta starts in November 2026 with design partners, and the official release is in January 2027.

ERIS combines eight core tools into one system: meetings with AI note-taking, task management, project management, document management, document signing, CRM, team chat and email. After the release, new modules are added every week or month.

ERIS runs on the company's own servers with a local AI model, so company data never leaves the building. Alternatively, smaller companies without their own hardware can use ERIS hosted by Upward on its own servers in the Netherlands, also with a local AI model.

The ERIS Assistant answers questions using all company data, documents and the internal knowledge base, and names its source. Every question and every AI action is logged: who asked, which data was used, what it did and the result. The assistant answers each person only from the data that person is allowed to open. A refused access is logged like every other question.

Unlike Slack, which is a communication platform, ERIS replaces your entire software stack. You get one login, one data layer, one audit trail and one price per user across all modules. All standard modules are included, and new standard modules come at no extra cost. Custom modules, agents and knowledge bases are billed as projects.

For a deeper look at how ERIS's AI works on your own hardware, see how on-premises AI keeps enterprise data inside the firewall.

Which one should you pick

Pick Slack if: you want a best-in-class messaging and collaboration platform, your team is already distributed across many tools and you want to integrate them into one conversation space, you need to connect external teams through Slack Connect, or you prefer a SaaS solution that requires no server maintenance.

Pick ERIS if: you want to replace your entire business software stack with one system, you cannot or will not send company data to outside cloud providers (for GDPR, EU AI Act, NIS2 or other regulatory reasons), you want an AI assistant that works across all your business data without sending it outside your company, or you want one login, one audit trail and one price per user instead of managing dozens of separate subscriptions.

Use both if: you choose ERIS for your core business system and want to keep Slack as your team communication layer. ERIS includes team chat, but some companies prefer Slack's messaging experience and integrate it with ERIS through custom modules.

For a comparison of how ERIS stacks up against other all-in-one business platforms, see best all-in-one business software.

FAQ

Can I use Slack inside ERIS?

ERIS includes its own team chat and email as part of the beta. You can integrate Slack with ERIS through custom modules and agents, which are billed as projects. Contact Upward Technologies to discuss your integration needs.

Does ERIS have a free plan like Slack?

ERIS is in development and not yet available. Pricing will be published on the ERIS page at upwardtech.nl when the beta begins. Slack offers a free plan with 90 days of message history and up to 10 apps.

Can I move my Slack history to ERIS?

ERIS is still in development. Once released, migration from Slack would depend on your specific data and setup. Contact Upward Technologies to discuss your needs.

Does ERIS work offline?

ERIS can run offline on the company's own servers. It is built to work on closed or isolated networks. Slack requires an internet connection.

What if I only need messaging, not a full business system?

Slack is the right choice if messaging and light project coordination are your main needs. ERIS is built for companies that want to replace their entire software stack. For companies that need both, using Slack for messaging alongside ERIS for business operations is a common approach.

How does ERIS's AI assistant differ from Slack's AI integrations?

Slack integrates AI agents from external providers like Salesforce Agentforce and Claude, so those interactions go through third-party services. ERIS runs a local AI model on your own servers, so the assistant reads and searches your company documents without sending them to an outside AI provider. See local AI assistant for company documents: how it works and what it takes for details.

Is ERIS available now?

ERIS is in development. The beta starts in November 2026 with design partners, and the official release is in January 2027. Request access to the ERIS beta.
